28 CANONICAL DIMENSIONS
Professionalism
92

Degree of formality, institutional polish, and structural discipline.

Playfulness
10

Whimsy, lighthearted interaction patterns, and energetic visual tone.

Luxury
45

Generous whitespace, premium materials, high craft, and aspirational restraint.

Warmth
30

Human approachability, organic rounding, soft contrast, and inviting tone.

Technicality
82

Scientific precision, monospace accents, data fidelity, and tool-like aesthetic.

Editorial
45

Magazine-like storytelling, prominent typography hierarchy, and reading rhythm.

Futurism
25

Forward-looking aesthetic, luminous accents, cyber/spatial cues, and modern edge.

Visual Ambition
30

Expressive surface design budget, from essential clarity to experimental spectacle.

Structural Creativity
20

Information architecture freedom, from familiar conventions to inventive layouts.

Density
75

Information compactness and component tightness.

Whitespace
50

Breathing room, margins, and negative space allocation.

Contrast
85

Value separation between foreground elements, text, and canvas backgrounds.

Colourfulness
25

Chroma saturation, palette breadth, and chromatic accents across surfaces.

Curvature
25

Corner radius progression from crisp rectangular edges to pill shapes.

Depth
25

Elevation, multi-layer shadows, surface bevels, and atmospheric layering.

Motion
25

Overall animation intensity, transition durations, and interface movement.

Motion Playfulness
10

Spring physics, overshoot, bounce, and kinetic micro-delight vs linear precision.

Typographic Expression
35

Hero scale variance, display font character, and custom typographic weight.

Imagery Intensity
20

Dependence on photography, illustrations, and visual assets.

Video Intensity
0

Use of looping video backgrounds, motion previews, and cinematic media.

3D Intensity
0

Spatial objects, WebGL canvasses, and simulated 3D depth.

Data Density
85

Concentration of tables, charts, metrics, and quantitative summaries.

Interaction Density
75

Action targets, shortcuts, quick controls, and interactive widgets per view.

Asymmetry
10

Intentional imbalance, broken grids, and off-axis visual weight.

Conversion Intensity
25

Prominence of calls-to-action, pricing indicators, and activation incentives.

Trust & Credibility
96

Security emphasis, compliance cues, social proof, and stability signals.

Accessibility Priority
90

Contrast floor, keyboard focus visual prominence, and reduced-motion enforcement.

Performance Priority
88

Weight budget, lazy loading strictness, and low-complexity asset choices.
